title: Onboard aurora-edge-13b v1.0 — perf profiles, metadata, changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Added aurora-edge-13b v1.0 model metadata and performance profiles; automatic changelog generation for model registry updates; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context: aurora-edge is a trimmed 13B variant optimized for low-memory inference on edge-class accelerators. This PR adds v1.0 model metadata, curated performance profiles for supported instance types, and hooks into the changelog automation so releases appear in the registry history. Motivation: give customers a vetted, low-latency option for constrained deployments and ensure consistent release notes. Changes include: 1) model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, quantization recommendations, memory footprint, supported sequence lengths), 2) performance profiles produced by the perf-lab benchmarking suite (throughput/latency numbers, batch/seq knobs), 3) metadata versioning and schema migration logic (compatibility with previous registry entries), 4) changelog/release notes automation updates so onboarding events are surfaced to the web UI and release feed. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata json and schema validation - [x] Add performance profiles for: g4dn, t4, a2, small-edge GPUs - [x] Integrate perf-lab CI artifact upload and linking - [x] Add changelog automation trigger and template - [x] Unit and integration tests for registry ingestion and changelog generation - [x] Docs: registry onboarding guide + release notes snippet Notes and decisions: - Quantization recommendation uses int8-ggml by default for edge; we include fallback quantized variants under metadata. - Memory numbers are conservative (10% headroom) to avoid OOM on lower-tier devices. - Performance profiles are annotated with the test harness git sha for reproducibility. Migration: schema bump handled via the registry-migrations runner; existing entries unaffected. Rollout: canary onboard to staging Dedicated pool, monitor latency and token-level cost for 48h, then promote to main catalog if no regression. Related: ENG-4201, PM-318. See linked perf artifacts in the CI build logs.
